external_checkers.drat-trim: NOT RUN: not installed and not available as a package

findings.summary: dratify kept a literal in the root assignment after deleting the only clause implying it, on both engines, so it returned ok=True on satisfiable formulas
rate, with unit deletions honoured, rejects proofs dratify accepts because dratify documents ignoring them; rate -d agrees with dratify
rate verifies a proof that reaches a propagation conflict without writing the empty clause; dratify documents rejecting it
rate's backward modes verify proofs with an invalid unused lemma; dratify and rate -f reject them, as the README documents

not_checked: drat-trim itself: not installed, no package install provides it, and its source is on GitHub, outside this campaign's network rule. Its invocation and stdout parsing were exercised only against shell stubs in --self-test.
rate with no -p flag, where it tries every literal as a pivot
rate's LRAT and GRAT output, and DPR proofs
binary DRAT: dratify documents text proofs only
minisat: it writes no DRAT proof, so it contributed no proofs
formulas past 16 variables, so no proof of realistic size; the README's uuf and php benchmarks are bench/repro.py's job
tautological clauses in the input formula, and DIMACS parsing corners
the list-of-steps and MemoryProof paths into check_proof: only proof text is passed
